submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 gives the highest signal efficiency at the 8 kHz allocation in my emulation at 35 GeV: L3 91.3%, L1 86.7%, L2 74.0%. This agrees with the 2025 summary. CAVEAT: I found no latency figure for any candidate in the documents, and no tool reports latency. The 4.0 us hard limit is therefore unverified for every option. L3 is iterative, so it is the one most likely to exceed the limit. This recommendation is conditional on an FPGA latency check or synthesis report for L3. If L3 fails that check, fall back to Algorithm-L1, then L2. I scanned only 35 GeV, so the threshold is not optimized.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm is one of the three candidates

requirements.evidence: No document or tool gives latency for any candidate. candidate_specs.md only says all fit the resource budget (LUTs, DSPs). It does not cover timing. L3 is iterative, so this is a real risk.
